title: Champion View Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: This home includes FREE Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort passes in 2026. The Hilton Waikoloa Village Resort was voted the #1 resort in Hawaii by USA Today. Normally, resort passes cost $100/adult and $60/child, but when staying at this home, use for up to 12 people is COMPLIMENTARY with no additional cost each and every day of your stay. This includes use of resort pools, the river pool, waterslides, a hot tub, a saltwater lagoon for snorkeling, lounge chairs, towels, and parking validation for one vehicle. It also includes a 10% discount on Spa Treatments, 10% discount on Lagoon toys, and Cabana rentals. Guests love this resort pass, which gives them the best of both worlds with hotel privileges and a comfortable, well-equipped vacation home. Accommodating up to 14 guests, this sophisticated residence features three Master Suites, each offering a unique blend of comfort and opulence. The main Master Suite, with a plush king bed and spa-like ensuite, is mere steps from the pool, creating a serene oasis. Additional suites cater to various sleeping arrangements, including a room with Twin XL beds convertible to a King, and a bonus bedroom perfect for younger guests. The spacious living areas, including a well-appointed living room and elegant lanais, invite relaxation. With a private pool, hot tub, and high-end grill on the covered lanai, this home is ideal for family gatherings or vacations with friends, where every detail is designed for an extraordinary Hawaiian escape.
